content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Richland

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a bachelor's degree plus project-management experience, or a high-school diploma with additional experience. Review PMI's formal education and hands-on project-leadership requirements to confirm you meet the credential's baseline. Granite PM Academy can clarify whether your background qualifies.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP training. Our Richland-based instructors deliver the PMI-required contact hours in a flexible format that fits working professionals. You'll master the PMBOK Guide and exam domains while building a peer network in your region.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, apply directly to PMI with proof of your education and project experience. Pay the PMI examination fee when you submit. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on documentation and the online application process to ensure a smooth submission.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-prep resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor office hours—to build confidence. Schedule your PMP exam through Pearson VUE. Our instructors remain available to answer questions and address knowledge gaps before your test date.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, earn professional development units (PDUs) across a three-year renewal cycle to keep your PMP active. Granite PM Academy offers continuing education and PDU-eligible courses to support your ongoing growth and compliance with PMI's maintenance requirements.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
